text: ok now go through every single part and add in undo and redo capabilities
resolution: Added one chronological native undo/redo transaction boundary for every UV-authoring mutation: island/group/face and vertex moves, rotation, scaling, flips, numeric edits, size matching, chains, packing, texture import, and texture reload. Restores exact UVs, atlas pixels and dimensions, package artifacts, layers, editable stroke/shader recipes, raster baseline, and paint history; view-only selection, pan, zoom, grid choice, and aspect lock intentionally remain outside document history. Added scoped panel controls, action labels/events, no-op rejection, branch-safe paint interaction, native/TypeScript regressions, and a green ReleaseFast editor build.
